nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 - Semantic Bridge (Better Prompt Adherence)

This workflow adds the **MiniMax H3 Semantic Bridge** — a small (~11 MB) adapter that improves how faithfully H3 follows your prompt. It sits on H3's text-conditioning path and applies a learned semantic representation with magnitude matching and a controlled residual blend, without merging any weights into the diffusion model.

**Recommended: use the standard (fl2va) model.** The Semantic Bridge was distilled from H3's standard text-conditioning path, so it's built for fl2va — prefer it if you have it. It runs on ref2va too (fine for text-to-video), but the author found ref2va gave worse results in audio/singing tests, so fl2va is the safer choice, especially for lip movement.

**Honest note on results:** the author presents the improvement as qualitative evidence from a controlled A/B comparison, not a guaranteed universal gain. It helps prompt adherence in their tests; your mileage will vary by prompt.

The Lora toggle in the Fast Groups Bypasser turns the lightx2v turbo LoRA on/off, so you can run this with or without turbo. Spectrum node is present but disabled by default.

Semantic Bridge by **speach1sdef178**: https://huggingface.co/speach1sdef178/MiniMax-H3-Semantic-Bridge

nodes.title: Note: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**Base H3 models** (Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3):
- diffusion_models/ -> minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/unet/
- text_encoders/ -> qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/clip/
- vae/ -> minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors + minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/vae/

**Semantic Bridge adapter** (by speach1sdef178) -> ComfyUI/models/unet/ (loaded via distilled_adapter):
- MiniMaxH3_SemanticBridge_v1.safetensors

**Custom node** ships as a ZIP in the same repo (not on the Manager):
- MiniMax_H3_Semantic_Bridge_v1.0.zip -> extract into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/, then restart ComfyUI

Optional turbo: minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step... in loras/ (toggle in the bypasser). Set CLIPLoader type to krea2.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, photorealistic science-fiction, a medium full-body three-quarter shot frames a slim adult woman standing beside a large panoramic porthole inside an advanced deep-space spacecraft. She has dark hair in an asymmetrical futuristic cut, with a dramatic side-swept fringe covering part of her forehead and one side shaved close to the scalp, natural texture and volume; she wears a sleek, fitted red space suit with realistic fabric, subtle reflective panels, and functional technological detailing. The interior shows brushed metallic surfaces, illuminated control panels, and soft blue ambient lighting, while a vast starfield, distant planets, and colorful nebulae with faint cosmic dust glow beyond the glass. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she gazes out at the cosmos with a calm, confident expression, cool rim light from the stars tracing the edge of her suit and face. She slowly turns her head toward the window, and faint reflections of the nebula drift across her skin and the suit's surface.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of her face in three-quarter view, the porthole's cosmic light reflecting in her eyes. She blinks softly and exhales, her expression steady and contemplative, while volumetric light and subtle film grain settle over the frame and the distant planetary glow shifts slowly behind her.

overall_soundscape: A low continuous hum of the spacecraft's systems fills the cabin, layered with soft electronic beeps from the control panels and a faint air-circulation whir. Quiet fabric movement accompanies her turning, and a single soft exhale is audible in the close-up.

non_diegetic_music: Sustained synth pads at a slow tempo with sparse, widely spaced piano-like tones, joined by a gentle low drone that gradually swells and then eases back.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a young woman dancing happily in the center of a bright, softly lit studio with a white backdrop. The camera holds a mostly static shot with a slight push in at slow speed as she moves in time with the music, spinning and swaying with a wide smile. As she dances, her outfit transforms in a smooth, continuous morph: from a light floral sundress into a tailored business suit, then into soft pajamas, then into a plain red lifeguard swimsuit, then into fitted gym attire, and finally back into the original floral sundress. Each change flows seamlessly with her motion without interrupting the dance, her expression cheerful and energetic throughout.

overall_soundscape: The soft sounds of fabric shifting and footsteps tapping against the studio floor as she dances, with a light room ambience underneath.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat, cheerful pop track at a lively tempo with a bright melody, steady danceable rhythm, and a warm major key that carries energy from start to finish.
